subtitle: Out Cebu · Vietjet Airlines
overview: Fly Cebu to Hanoi with Vietjet Airlines and spend three nights in local 4-star hotels in Sapa, Hanoi and Ha Long Bay. You will explore Hanoi’s Old Quarter, ride the Fansipan cable car and enjoy an exclusive Ha Long Bay cruise with lunch and afternoon tea on board. A private coach and English-speaking guide are included, along with 20 kg baggage. This is a no-shopping package.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Cebu, Dec 1–5 2026 to Mar 23–27 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Hoan Kiem Lake: A central lake in Hanoi, a favourite walking area beside the Old Quarter.
placeDesc.36 Streets (Old Quarter): Hanoi's historic district of narrow streets, traditionally named after the trades once sold there.
placeDesc.Sapa Tourist Street: The main pedestrian street of Sapa town, lined with shops and cafes.
placeDesc.Sapa Church: A stone church in the centre of Sapa town, beside the main square.
placeDesc.Love Square: An open square in the middle of Sapa town, visited on the evening of arrival.
placeDesc.Moana Coffee: A coffee stop in Sapa visited in the morning before the Fansipan trip.
placeDesc.Muong Hoa Mountain Railway: A mountain railway linking Sapa Town to the Fansipan Cable Car Station, taken as a round trip.
placeDesc.Fansipan Cable Car: A cable car up to the Fansipan Peak area with panoramic mountain and valley views.
